items.note: Gives h, N, m, I, both gate rules, the eight-row schedule, the net change (JV+RG)x independent of scratch, the bit and complex coefficient checks, the three-stage composition (x,y)->(-y,x) and the wire counts W_b, W_c, exactly as in the proof. The headline calls all three stages 'forward invocations' although the middle one is the inverse schedule, but the parenthetical and S2.1.4 put it right.

errors.says: 'Three forward invocations of an eight-row schedule ... (from X to Y, the inverse schedule from Y to X, then X to Y)'.
errors.paper: Stage 1 is a forward invocation from X to Y, stage 2 is the inverse forward schedule from Y to X (effecting X<-X-Y), and stage 3 is again forward. Only two of the three are forward invocations; the plan's own parenthetical and S2.1.4 give the correct version.

errors.says: The Neumann evaluation's 'tape movement over windows of radius about sqrt(p) alpha costs O(tp sqrt(p) alpha)'.
errors.paper: The radius ceil(sqrt p) alpha belongs to the S' procedure's window. The Neumann evaluation's E~ calls use windows of radius m=ceil(sqrt p/(2alpha)), each costing O(tp(1+sqrt p/alpha)); over k-1<=alpha^2 calls this totals O(tp sqrt(p) alpha).

errors.says: The algorithm '... apply the opposite source transform and the two scales by S, undo Phi, round to integers and propagate carries'.
errors.paper: Step 5 rounds the scaled values to integers at each valid address and only then applies Phi^{-1} with padding removal; carries come after Phi^{-1}. S8.8 states this order correctly.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound. S2 builds the bank-exchange network, frames, labels, both interfaces and the rank saving s<Wm with tau=1-2^{-50}, then turns it into the O(Vu^tau) interchange and the O(Vd^{lambda'}) layer. S3-S4 give synthetic transforms, convolution, resampling and chirp/permutation cancellation; S5-S8 give parameters, CRT, twist and the algorithm; S9 gives exact recovery and S10 the margin accounting to O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}). There is no break. The only thin spots are the elementary stream and controlled-shift lemmas, which are used but never stated, and the conjecture-negation clause, which is only asserted.

steps.note: S2.1.1 gives h=100, banks X_a,Y_a indexed by a in T^3, N=v^3 with v=binom(100,3) and m=h^3. S2.1 and S2.1.5 give the fixed linear network sending (X_a,Y_a) to (-Y_a,X_a) and restoring every scratch wire whatever its initial value.

Gives a common invertible frame per gate commuting with the pointwise gate by R-linearity, so the network implements D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}. Edges only change frame, and intermediate frames are free to make edges cheap.
Labels are nondegenerate subspaces of F^{tensor 3} of dimension m, and every edge joins comparable labels. The only decreasing edges are the central wires 3->4, each losing P (x) F of dimension h.
For nested nondegenerate U in V, rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U. The N source edges are the exceptions: 2P_{U_a} has rank one where the dimension change is zero.
Sum of |Delta dim| is Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, from source sum N and sink sum Wm-N telescoping at gates. Adding the N source ranks gives s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
L/N=3ch/v gives 100/539 (bit) and 101/539 (complex), both below 1/2. So the deficit N-2L_b>0 (and 2N-2L_c>0) and s<Wm.

M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m on every role (P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m for X_a; zero source and identity sink otherwise). Hence the physical output is Phi_{I_m} f_w, the shear H<-H+D on every row including scratch rows.
A rank-a shear factors as E_1 Pi E_2 and costs exactly a interchanges plus O(V); each edge Phi_{A_e} is implemented by recursive interchanges, so a node makes exactly s recursive calls.
Children have volume V/W, so F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) and F_k=O(e^tau). The plan also derives s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the whole central chain with its defining quantities. The chain runs: the fixed h=100 exchange network; frames commuting with pointwise gates; nested labels with only the central 3->4 edges decreasing by h; rank equal to dimension change plus N source ranks; budget s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b; L/N=100/539<1/2, so s<Wm; the endpoint identity giving the shear on every role; edges as exactly s recursive interchanges; and the recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with tau=1-2^{-50}. All nine steps are reconstructed.
